item.text: {"prompt":"Create a square, full-bleed nonrepresentational abstract painting that fills the entire canvas edge to edge, with no border or frame. Suggest a felt inner state through color, contrast, brushwork, gesture, texture, density, layering, rhythm, spatial tension, and empty space. Build a deep midnight-blue and charcoal field, crossed by turbulent strokes of electric cobalt, bruised violet, and small eruptions of hot coral and pale gold. Let some marks arrive with sharp, sudden force, while others dissolve into thin translucent veils and quiet pools of near-black. Balance crowded, interwoven passages against broad, breathing areas of stillness; allow layers to scrape, bleed, drag, and partially erase one another. Make the composition feel alert, searching, and unresolved, with energy gathering and dispersing across the surface. Purely abstract: no recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. No room, wall, gallery setting, or external surroundings."}
